text: Holy Mary, Mother of God, all Angels and Saints, here I am led by the wish to bring help to the unborn children. I hereby vow to embrace one child, whose name is only known to God, with my Spiritual Adpotion and to pray for the next 9 month that his life be spared and full of justice and integrity. I vow to recite one mystery of the holy rosary every day and to undertake my voluntary sacrifices for the child.
